But be sure not to touch them when they are awake and kickin'! There are lots of hidden items at every scenario. Try to find where they are located, as they are pretty useful! Most of them gives you points, but some of them can feature certain effects.

201946.overview: In this graphical text adventure your aim is to kill to the count... To achieve this you will have to find the stake and the hammer.

202217.overview:
Merciless aliens are overrunning a small planet, they took by surprise to all the army. Now the last remaining defense is the Mecha Research's Lab and its unique two mechas, but them are the most powerful! Go ahead and guide Tricia Thunder on board Mecha-8 to gain again the freedom!

It was presented at the MSXdev'11 contest and later an enhanced version was released in physical format.

202219.overview: In this turn-based strategy game, the player will take command of the Mega Super X military in the fight against neighbor countries Ataranakya and Kami Doa, as well as mysterious outside invaders.

202220.overview: Mecha Taisen On Planet Oldskool Plus improves and fixes bugs of the MSXdev 06 entry Mecha Taisen on Planet Oldskool.

202221.overview:
In a distant galaxy, far far away, not the one with the asthmatic dark helmet pal, another one more further... There is an alien alliance lead by a civilization of women called Red Bikini who want´s the invasion of our galaxy.

On earth there is no weapon more powerful than atomic missiles, but nuclear disarmament has left almost no arms to our planet, only remains to reassemble some old missiles of the Cold War '60s.

Communications sound the alert, our space colonies are under attack. Soon the alien army coming to our beautiful blue planet.

202222.overview: The evildoers have spread the secret formulas of the great magician Merlin, throughout the corners of his immense castle. Can you help him get them back, so he can make the Philosopher's Stone?

202243.overview:
2050 A.D. The world has been under attack and is destroyed by aliens. You are Roger Smith, a cosmo pilot, who has survived the attack by leaving with your spaceship just on time.

To your knowledge, next to lots of innocent victims, all retro home computers including all MSX computers are destroyed during the attack. Just when you almost gave up hope to ever play retro games again, you receive a message of the former Russian intellegance service:

Dear Roger, despite of earlier reports that space station Mir was destroyed in 2001, inner sources confirm that space station Mir never has been destroyed at all. Last years the station has been in use as a secret Russian testing base. At the moment it is floating steerless in space.

Roger Smith, please enter the fight with the aliens and save the last MSX computer in the univers... your Mission 2 Mir starts!

203887.overview: You take the role of Mr. Cracksman, the thief. You must travel each stage trying to get coins and treasures, taking care of not getting caught by the policemen. If you get every coin in the stage, you will proceed to a new level.

203900.overview: MSX conversion of and old hand held, where you control a chef who has to shoot the sausages that are flying over you, whose also will shoot you.

203959.overview: A break-out clone starring a mole. It was presented in the MSXdev'07 contest.

203999.overview: A top-down tank game for 1-4 players submitted to the MSXdev'11 contest.

204116.overview: Mutants from the Deep is a submarine shooting game. Choose your character, enhance your gear and fire your weapons in 8 directions as you swim into the dangers of the deep.

213386.overview: The Menace from Triton is a horizontal shooting game inspired in some of MSX classic shooters like Salamander or the Nemesis saga, but with elements of a few modern shooter games (in particular Steredenn and Z-Exemplar). The game combines arcade-style horizontal shooter action with the resource managing/shop mechanics of Z-Exemplar, and the procedural generation of Steredenn. The first levels start out quite easy, but the game gets harder and harder towards the end. So, make sure you upgrade your ship as much as possible, or it will be impossible to defeat Triton!

419750.overview:
While Tricia Thunder fights his way aboard Mecha-8, Ryan Rock does same inside Mecha-9, but things look way more complicated for him!

Isn't a sequel nor a prequel, Mecha-9 story happens at same time of Mecha-8 ;)

462432.overview:
The game My Sacred Place is an action strategy RPG in which you have to protect your village’s garden from the clutches of the fearsome Garks. It’s an MSX1 compatible game by Mario Cavalcanti from Brazil.

At night, when it’s dark and shadows disappear, the world changes into a dangerous place luring many demons in. Submitting to that lure will easily result in a quick death for the untrained. But to kung-fu fighter Yu Tao, the dark is very appealing, as it’s a good opportunity to show off his mad skills. Yu Tao is fast as lightning. In fact, it’s a little bit frightening. The world is his dojo and his chopping game is on.

When demons appear after sun-set, Yu Tao is the sole protector of the sacred village garden. What happens to the garden, happens to Yu Tao, so make sure he gets rid of them nasty Garks. Garks are terrifying fire-red furry demons that love to eat veggies. While chewing stuff up is their game, it’s ginger root that scares them.

During the day time, Yu Tao needs training to earn money for protective ginger and offensive silver daggers. Armed with just that and some deadly fists, Yu Tao is ready when night falls. With the help of Aris the Witch and Isao the sage, and of course those mad fighting skills, he might fulfill his destiny after all.

The colour palette of My Sacred Place is optimized on MSX2 (or higher) computers, and can be played either with a keyboard or a joystick.

Did you enjoy this MSXdev game? Well, why not consider donating to the prize money or sponsor the winners loot box by submitting a physical reward? 100% of the donations will go to the developers.
